selection_rationale: Moderate request frequency; well-understood domain vocabulary; directly testable journeys.
required_journeys: create or add a new customer record
edit or update an existing record
expected_ui_components: edit record form or inline editing
expected_backend_behavior: customer list returns array with id, name, email or contact fields
create customer persists and returns the new customer
update customer accepts partial payload and reflects changes
acceptance_criteria: Customer list renders with domain-specific labels (customer name, email, not 'entity')
Create customer form submits to the backend and the new record appears in the list
Customer detail shows at minimum name and one contact field
QA report includes evidence for at least 3 of the 4 required journeys
example_pass: Customer list shows 3+ entries with name/email; clicking a row opens detail; add form creates and reloads list.
example_fail: Table renders 'Sample Customer 1' with no clickable rows; create button opens an alert('not implemented').
